Cross-Platform Builds > Build Verification and Troubleshooting

Build Verification and Troubleshooting

Recommended Verification Order

# 运行目录：sci 仓库根目录
zig build                          # 1. 默认全构建（含 LLVM 后端，需 llvm-14-dev）
zig build core -Dllvm=false        # 2. 跨平台核心检查（快）
zig build sa-std-unit              # 3. 标准运行时单元测试（含 FreeBSD 解析器用例）
zig build test                     # 4. 完整门禁（慢，10 分钟以上；见下）
# 交叉目标逐个验证（见矩阵总览与各章节）：
zig build -Dtarget=x86_64-windows-gnu -Dllvm=false -p /tmp/sa-win
zig build -Dtarget=aarch64-linux-gnu -Dllvm=false -p /tmp/sa-arm
zig build -Dtarget=aarch64-macos -Dllvm=false -p /tmp/sa-mac
sh tools/build_freebsd.sh --prefix /tmp/sa-fbsd

Known Phenomena (Not Code Problems)

PhenomenonCauseHandling
wasm-matrix / some plugin-host-smoke report LLVM-C backend is disabledThe build passed -Dllvm=false; the related tests need the LLVM backendInstall llvm-14-dev and rerun with the default switches
sa_std dynamic loading helpers are usable from C reports FileNotFound (zig-out/lib)An earlier -p installed the products elsewhere, so the default zig-out/lib is missingRun a default zig build once, then test again
stdlib.h / dlfcn.h file not found (freebsd target)The FreeBSD sysroot is missing (Zig does not ship the freebsd libc)Follow the script/manual flow in the FreeBSD Cross-Compilation page
unable to find or provide libc for target 'x86_64-freebsd…'Only -Dsysroot was passed; the -Dlibc description file is missingGenerate freebsd-libc.txt as in the script and pass it in
undefined symbol: _c_recvmsg (macOS dylib linking)Old code, already fixed: an extern name must match the libc's real symbolUpdate main to a version containing that fix
std.net.if_nametoindex unimplemented for this OS (freebsd)Old code, already fixed: see the FreeBSD compatibility layerUpdate main to a version containing that fix
A bare zig test src/runtime/sa_std.zig reports a posix @bitCast size mismatchThe bare test does not link libc and takes std's non-libc path; the project's proper entry point is zig build sa-std-unit (with link_libc)Use zig build sa-std-unit instead

Build Side Effects

zig build syncs the built library back into the source tree at artifacts/sa_std/libsa_std.a (a git-tracked file). When you are only verifying locally, restore it at the end with git checkout -- artifacts/sa_std/libsa_std.a, keeping the working tree clean.
